N4571A-27-R-0002 Page 13 of 106 Truth-seeking means the LLM is truthful in responding to user prompts seeking factual information or analysis. The LLM prioritizes historical accuracy, scientific inquiry, and objectivity, and acknowledges uncertainty where reliable information is incomplete or contradictory. Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. Significant Modifications means any changes made by the contractor or subcontractor to the AI model that could reasonably be expected to alter its adherence to the Unbiased AI Principles. For the purposes of compliance with the Unbiased AI Principles, this definition includes, but is not limited to, changes to training data and model architecture, and alterations to filtering and content moderation. (b) Contractor Obligation. The contractor must ensure that any LLM or other AI model provided under this contract complies with the Unbiased AI Principles throughout the period of performance. Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. Täitjale tõlkimise eest makstavad tasumäärad on erinevad, arvestades tõlkemälu põhjal arvutatud tekstikordusi: 0–74% vastavus tõlkemälule = 100% kokkulepitud tasumäärast; 75–99% vastavus tõlkemälule = 60% kokkulepitud tasumäärast; 100% vastavus tõlkemälule ja kordused = 30% kokkulepitud tasumäärast. Tõlkemälu põhjal arv

teostatud ja vastuvõetud tööde eest. Kõik lepingu muudatused peavad olema poolte vahel kokku lepitud kirjalikus vormis. Muudatused jõustuvad allakirjutamise momendist või kokkulepitud tähtajal. Poolte kokkuleppel või seaduses sätestatud juhtudel võib lepingu lõpetada lepingu punktis 7.5 sätestatud etteteatamistähtaega rakendamata. Muud tingimused Kõik lepingust tulenevad vaidlused ja erimeelsused püüavad pooled lahendada läbirääkimiste teel. Juhul kui läbirääkimised ei anna tulemusi, lahendatakse vaidlused Harju Maakohtus. Täitjale tööde teostamise käigus teatavaks saanud mis tahes informatsioon on konfidentsiaalne ega kuulu avaldamisele kolmandatele isikutele. Juhul kui täitja ja/või tema töötaja on avaldanud kolmandale isikule või isikutele konfidentsiaalset informatsiooni, mis sai talle teatavaks lepingu täitmise käigus, ning on sellise avaldamisega tekitanud tellijale kahju, vastutab täitja nimetatud kahju tekkimise eest ja on kohustatud hüvitama nimetatud kahju faktilises ulatuses.
